newsitem.title: DENMARK: Foreign interest keeps Danish bond prices strong.
newsitem.headline: Foreign interest keeps Danish bond prices strong.

text.p: Foreign buyers kept Danish bond prices buoyant in Tuesday afternoon trade, with the eight percent state bond due 2003 a particular beneficiary.

"A good few of the eight percent 2003 were sold abroad early on Tuesday and the series is the most traded, with turnover of 2.9 billion crowns," a dealer said. At 1300 GMT it was up 0.25 points, to 109.99, yielding 6.07 percent.

The benchmark eight percent state bond due 2006 traded at 108.48, yielding 6.73 percent, up 0.22 point from Monday in turnover of 1.2 billion crowns. Its December future rose 0.21 point to 108.32 with 48 contracts traded.
